messages:
Priya Raman: Orchard reported a big p99/p95 regression on their tenant starting ~08:12 UTC. p99 jumped to ~5.2s from baseline ~600ms for text-generation calls. They're seeing timeouts in their app. sample request_id=orch-req-00123, region=eu-west-1, model=redwood/llama-13b-v2
Diego Ruiz: looking. do we have traces for orch-req-00123? any error codes or just high latency?
Priya Raman: no 5xxs, requests succeed but slow. They attached a short trace snippet (sent to ops): ""
- recv at gateway: 2026-03-15T08:12:07Z
- routed to pool: eu-w1-gpu-pool-3
- queue wait: 3200ms
- runtime tokenization+decode: 1800ms
""
Samir Patel: queue wait 3200ms suggests hot queue / noisy neighbor or batching config change. any deploys around that time? @deploy-bot can you confirm deploys?
deploy-bot: deploy redwood/runtime v3.4.7 rolled to eu-west-1 at 2026-03-15T07:58:40Z (id: dpl-9091) :rocket:
Mira Chen: I see increased KV cache miss rate for that pool starting 07:59 — matches deploy window. miss_rate went from 4% to 28% for recent prefix patterns.
Jules Park: @Diego could this be kernel selection fallback after the runtime upgrade? fallback to slower kernels sometimes spikes tail.
Diego Ruiz: plausible. hypothesis: runtime v3.4.7 changed quantization kernel path for 13b, causing some requests to hit a slower code path, plus co-tenants with heavy long-context requests filled the batch window -> long queue waits.
Priya Raman: orchard says their traffic is fairly steady, no sudden burst. they tested 5 identical requests and p99 persisted. they asked for a mitigation asap.
Samir Patel: immediate mitigations we can try: 1) route orchard requests to a different pool (eu-w1-gpu-pool-7) with lower load; 2) apply a temporary per-tenant concurrency cap to reduce noisy neighbor impact; 3) pin them to previous runtime variant if possible. Which is fastest?
Diego Ruiz: order: (1) route to different pool via per-tenant routing override — fastest (seconds). (2) if that fails, apply per-tenant throttle to limit concurrent in-flight requests to 8. (3) rollback subset of runtime on a canary — needs eng-runtime.
Mira Chen: routing override ready as a config change. sample curl to create routing rule:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/routing
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
 -d '{"tenant":"orchard","match":{"region":"eu-west-1"},"route_to":"eu-w1-gpu-pool-7","priority":100}'
```
Priya Raman: going to request exec of that now. I'll paste results.
Priya Raman: (2m later) routing rule applied. early telemetry: queue_wait median dropped from 1.2s -> 140ms for orchard prefixed requests. p99 dropped from 5.2s -> 720ms. customer reporting improvement but still above baseline. :thumbsup:
Diego Ruiz: great. we should also check pool-7 kernel profile — ensure it uses optimized path. Mira, can you run quick kernel diff and confirm no fallback?
Mira Chen: running. initial check: pool-7 still on runtime v3.4.6 for that node set, which uses the older kernel path. kernel diff: v3.4.7 introduced fallback for fused-attn when sequence > 2048 which triggers slower path for some request shapes.
Samir Patel: long-term fix options: 1) backport optimized fused-attn to v3.4.7; 2) patch routing to avoid mixing long-context tenants with short-context; 3) talk to Orchard about dedicated capacity / reservation.
Jules Park: also consider allowlist for orchard to bypass global fairshare so their concurrency doesn't get penalized by noisy neighbors — temporary until we resolve. Priya, legal ok with that?
Priya Raman: legal signed off on temporary customer-specific allowlist for rate-limiter exceptions. I've opened ticket CS-4621 to track.
Diego Ruiz: applying temporary per-tenant allowlist now (limit: allow 12 burst concurrent, exempt from fairshare)
Priya Raman: (action) applied allowlist at 08:34 UTC. orchard p99 now ~560ms on recent tests, back to baseline. customer confirmed app healthy.
Samir Patel: follow-ups: - eng-runtime to backport fused-attn fix (ticket RT-1187) - platform to add routing rule automation to prefer older stable runtime during rollout (ticket PL-2920) - sales/CS discuss dedicated reserved capacity offer to Orchard (ticket CS-4622)
Mira Chen: saved traces and logs to internal S3 path: s3://redwood-ops/traces/1905554321-orchard/ — added to the incident thread.
Diego Ruiz: closing immediate incident; root cause = runtime v3.4.7 kernel fallback + noisy co-tenants causing long queue waits. Mitigation = route to pool with older kernel + temporary allowlist.
Priya Raman: customer follow-up scheduled for tomorrow 09:30 UTC. will propose dedicated reservation + postmortem summary. thanks everyone. :pray:
